title: Nonlocal Fourier Laws for Heat Propagation via Fractional powers of Vector Operators
summary: The present work is devoted to the study of fractional powers of vector operators, with particular emphasis on the gradient operator with non-constant coefficients. Within the setting of Clifford algebra $\mathbb{R}_n$, this operator turns out to have bisectorial properties. By applying the spectral theory on the $S$-spectrum, we address a fundamental mathematical challenge: unlike sectorial operators, bisectorial operators involve fractional powers that are not analytic on the negative real line.
